confidence_notes: Hualien price summaries broadly agree on meals and coffee, but accommodation tax treatment varies and several pages were refreshed after July, so they are proxies for that window. The cocktail estimate uses a local bar-guide range; wine is estimated at roughly four times restaurant beer because the local per-glass menu evidence found was resort-priced.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used direct Hualien city price summaries; Taiwan-wide restaurant prices served only as a cross-check.
